title: Mutemo
description: Mutes the whole game by pressing hotkey or some events.
body:
## Attention 1:
This mod is still in development. GUI and other things may be seriously changed. 
## Attention 2:
This mod is **NeoForge ONLY** and built for minecraft 1.20.4 and NeoForge 20.4.77-beta. Try launching on older versions at your own risk.  
DO NOT RUN THIS MOD ON NEOFORGED MINECRAFT 1.20.1!!!

# Mutemo

**Allows you to mute all game sounds in one click!**

Features:
- Mute in one click by hitting hot key. 
- Can be configured from "Config" button in mod list.

Planning:
- Automute when minimized
- Automute when inactive

Maybe:
- Master volume control hotkeys
- Mute hotkey for each sound type

**Accept it as an reduced in functionality "Audio Hotkeys" port for NeoForge.**  
**^ ACTUALLY IT'S NOT, I WROTE IT FROM SCRATCH**

## Installing

Just drop it in "mods" folder.  
No lib-mods needed, everything is implemented directly
